name: CSV Rule Check
changes: The CSV Rule Check notice for a Pro feature now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Put the rules for people.csv in people.csv.schema.json in the same folder, and the check reads them.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. CSV Rule Check is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your CSV files.
